svg.text: EE22/08/13 (PC95) 2-LAYER REVERSIBLE-STACK 1:1 PLANAR TRANSFORMER — DIMENSIONS & ASSEMBLY
1 Single 2-Layer Gerber (30.00 × 28.00 mm, 0.80 mm FR-4, 1 oz Cu) | Stack 2 Identical Boards (Flip Top 180° in Y) → 12T:12T (1:1) | Mates to mosfet_gate_driver J14–J16
A. SINGLE 2-LAYER PCB GEOMETRY (30.00 × 28.00 mm, 100% Y-Symmetric Around Centerline)
B. REVERSIBLE 2-BOARD STACK CROSS-SECTION INSIDE EE22/08/13 (PC95) FERRITE CORE
4-STEP ZERO-JUMPER ASSEMBLY (USES ONLY 1 SINGLE 2-LAYER PCB DESIGN!):
Step 1 (Board 1 · Bottom = PRIMARY): Insert 1×4 male header (Pins 1–4); solder Pins 1 & 2 flush on Board 1 top (Pins 3–4 float inside Ø1.80 mm NPTH).
Step 2 (Insulation Barrier): Lay one 0.10 mm Kapton sheet (>4 kV dielectric) over Board 1 winding region (clear of left 1×4 header strip).
Step 3 (Board 2 · Top = SECONDARY): Take an IDENTICAL PCB, flip it 180° top-to-bottom (B.Cu UP — reads "SEC (TOP)"), slide onto Pins 1–4, solder Pins 3 & 4.
Step 4 (Core Fit): Slide the 2× EE22/08/13 (PC95) E-halves through the 3 slots (9.10 mm spare height inside 10.80 mm window!) and tape/clamp outer legs.
C. SYSTEM INTEGRATION — Mating 3× EE22 2-Layer 1:1 Modules to mosfet_gate_driver (a00c78f, J14–J16) & Verified Performance
– 10 µF, 25 V X7R DC-blocking cap (zero flux walk!)
inrush < 2.2 A; only 0.16 V drop at steady 35 mA RMS)
Feeds J1.10 (Trans_in1) & J1.11 (Trans_in2) on host PCB
• Order 10 pcs of 1 single 2L Gerber → 5 transformers (3+2 spares)
Exact 1×4 Pin-for-Pin Match to Host J14 / J15 / J16:
Pin 3 (PTH, Board 2) → Trans_A# (● Dot, Isolated Sec)
Connect each module to J14 / J15 / J16 via short 4-pin 2.54 mm jumper cable
3. VERIFIED AS-ROUTED ngspice-46 PERFORMANCE ON mosfet_gate_driver (a00c78f, 1N5819 + BC547/557)
• As-Routed Winding Specs: 12T CW : 12T CW (1:1), R_pri = R_sec = 0.925 Ω @ 25°C / 1.050 Ω @ 60°C, Lm = 720 µH nom, Llk = 1.57 µH, Cww = 42.9 pF
• Single-Channel Efficiency @ 200 kHz: 61.8% at 1.2 mA hold · 92.6–92.8% at 10 mA heavy burst · UF4007 fallback = 9.16 V V_GS
• 3-Channel End-to-End @ 12 V, 200 kHz: > 80% full system efficiency, ~90 ns gate rise/fall (1960 pF IRF540N), ΔT ≈ 0.19 °C (4.9 mW loss!)
HOST BOARD CHECKLIST BEFORE FABBING mosfet_gate_driver (a00c78f):
1. Fix short circuit (/P3 shorted to Net-(Q5-B)) + 0.0675 mm copper clearance error 2. Populate D1–D12 with fast Schottky (1N5819 / SB140), never 1N4007
3. Optional for >60 V battery packs: change J14–J16 to 1×5 with Pin 3 empty (triples Pri–Sec header creepage from 0.84 mm to 3.38 mm)
